summary: Frontend-only test of the redesigned /pricing page with interactive Credit Calculator + full Pack × Duration matrix. 63/65 assertions passed; the 2 non-passes are test-environment artifacts (huge viewport = nothing to scroll; pre-existing 401s from analytics/auth-me calls on public pages) and are NOT app defects. All functional requirements from the review request verified.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Pricing.jsx is ~400 lines and single-file — still under the 700-line threshold but is trending large; consider extracting the calculator + matrix into separate components if more sections are added.

Minor: The PLANS.refill field is unused for non-free plans (they render the anchor link instead). Consider removing the dead 'refill' field on paid plans or making the JSX branch use it explicitly for clarity.
